title: OpinionGPT: Modelling Explicit Biases in Instruction-Tuned LLMs
findings: The quantitative evaluation found that the model tuned for a 'conservative' bias displays the most negative sentiment towards Christianity, while the model tuned for a 'liberal' bias shows the most negative sentiment towards Islam.
